snippet.title: PlayStation - Simple 1500 Series Vol 027 - The SnowBoard (2000)
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
3D Snowboarding Made For Showy Tricks and Jumps!
2 Different Game Modes!
- Race mode - Play alone or compete against 2 other players.
- Trick Mode - Perform as many tricks as possible within the given time limit.
- 27 Different Courses.
- 3 Different Characters, each with different abilities.
- 2-Player Split Screen Mode.
